mapper.insert: /* SQL ID : OnlnPltfrmStngDAO.onlnPltfrmStngRegist 설 명 : 온라인플랫폼설정등록 */ MERGE INTO TB_LMS_ONLN_PLTFRM_STNG STNG USING ( SELECT #{onlnPltfrmStngId} AS ONLN_PLTFRM_STNG_ID , #{pltfrmGbncd} AS PLTFRM_GBNCD , #{orgId} AS ORG_ID , #{pltfrmCntnId} AS PLTFRM_CNTN_ID , #{pltfrmCntnClientId} AS PLTFRM_CNTN_CLIENT_ID , #{pltfrmCntnClientPswd} AS PLTFRM_CNTN_CLIENT_PSWD , #{rgtrId} AS RGTR_ID FROM DUAL ) STNG_PARAM ON ( STNG.ONLN_PLTFRM_STNG_ID = STNG_PARAM.ONLN_PLTFRM_STNG_ID AND STNG.PLTFRM_GBNCD = STNG_PARAM.PLTFRM_GBNCD AND STNG.ORG_ID = STNG_PARAM.ORG_ID ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET STNG.PLTFRM_CNTN_ID = STNG_PARAM.PLTFRM_CNTN_ID , STNG.PLTFRM_CNTN_CLIENT_ID = STNG_PARAM.PLTFRM_CNTN_CLIENT_ID , STNG.PLTFRM_CNTN_CLIENT_PSWD = STNG_PARAM.PLTFRM_CNTN_CLIENT_PSWD , STNG.MDFR_ID = STNG_PARAM.RGTR_ID , STNG.MOD_DTTM = FN_DTTM() WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( ONLN_PLTFRM_STNG_ID , PLTFRM_GBNCD , ORG_ID , PLTFRM_CNTN_ID , PLTFRM_CNTN_CLIENT_ID , PLTFRM_CNTN_CLIENT_PSWD , RGTR_ID , REG_DTTM ) VALUES ( STNG_PARAM.ONLN_PLTFRM_STNG_ID , STNG_PARAM.PLTFRM_GBNCD , STNG_PARAM.ORG_ID , STNG_PARAM.PLTFRM_CNTN_ID , STNG_PARAM.PLTFRM_CNTN_CLIENT_ID , STNG_PARAM.PLTFRM_CNTN_CLIENT_PSWD , STNG_PARAM.RGTR_ID , FN_DTTM() )
